description: In front of you is a toy kitchen counter with an open shelf full of clear plastic food containers and a bright green-lidded container, with a dishwasher door to the right. The left hand stays low near the shelf edge while the right hand reaches into the shelf, grips a clear container and pulls it out to the tabletop, then removes the green-lidded container and continues unstacking more clear containers from the upper shelf, placing them one by one in a row on the table.
